name: EUR / EPAL Pallet
note: 1500 kg is the commonly cited static max load; dynamic/racked capacity is lower and depends on the specific pallet's construction. Tare weight ~25kg is EPAL's own commonly published figure for a new wood block pallet (varies with moisture content) — consistent with the similarly-sized real UK Standard pallet's weight (25kg) observed directly in a live Cape Pack account.

name: EUR2 Pallet
note: Same construction family as EUR/EPAL, larger footprint. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint — exact weight varies by manufacturer.

name: US GMA Pallet (48x40in)
note: 48in x 40in is the most common North American pallet footprint; deck height and max load vary by manufacturer. Tare weight is a typical estimate for a stringer-style GMA pallet.

name: Half Pallet
note: Common retail-display half-size pallet, roughly half of EUR/EPAL footprint. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint.

name: ISO / Asia-Pacific Pallet (1100x1100mm)
note: One of the six ISO 6780 standard pallet footprints; the common square pallet size across much of Asia-Pacific. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint.
description: ISO 6780 square pallet, common in Asia-Pacific

name: Quarter Pallet
note: Roughly a quarter of EUR/EPAL footprint, used for retail point-of-sale displays. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint.

name: North American Pallet (42x42in)
note: One of the six ISO 6780 standard footprints; used in North America for square, non-GMA loads. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint.

name: Mixed-Use Pallet (48x42in)
note: One of the six ISO 6780 standard footprints; a common North American size for mixed/general merchandise. Tare weight is an estimate scaled from footprint.

name: Australian Standard Pallet
note: 1165x1165mm is the Australian national standard pallet footprint (one of the six ISO 6780 sizes). Max weight/tare are typical published figures; construction varies by manufacturer.

name: UK Standard Pallet
note: Same footprint as EUR2, listed separately under its common UK-market name (1200x1000x150mm) — this size and tare weight were directly observed as a real entry in a live Cape Pack account's Pallet library.
description: UK retail/logistics pallet, same footprint as EUR2
